address: Esplanade, Saint Helier, JE2 3QA, United Kingdom
bio: Overlooking St Aubin's Bay, this intimate restaurant inside the Grand Jersey Hotel offers a haven of luxury, not only in its opulent surroundings but also in the ingredients used. While you relax in the elegant room with linen-clad tables, you can expect to enjoy Jersey produce from blue lobster to Angus beef, not to mention excellent wild turbot. While their components are classically luxurious, there’s some playfully creative touches to the dishes. Bespoke wine flights are available to complement the cooking....
